items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Paul Shaffer with me this morning... [INTERVIEWEE] Yes. I cannot verify that my mojo is in fact working.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Paul Shaffer with me this morning for the Fillius Jazz Archive. It’s 11 AM-ish and that’s about the time most musicians get their mojo working. Thanks for joining me.
Yes. I cannot verify that my mojo is in fact working. However, if it is I certainly hope that it will work on you.
